main_text.l: Turtures, pisces, aves, opulentiorum cibi. Mostell. i. i. v. 44.
In delitijs erat sumen suis, τὸ ὑπερὸν ὑποκύλιον. Capt. 4. 3. v. 4.
Itemq; glandia. Capt. 4. 4. v. 7.
Pernæ item in delitijs. Capt. 4. 2. v. 70. & 4. 3. v. 4.
Itemque Apri valdè æstimati: inprimis lumbus aprugnus & Callus. Capt. 4. 3. v. 4.
De quo pluribus vide Hier. Mercurial. lib. 2. c. 22. Var. nec non Lips. in Poliorc. lib. 4. Dial. 1.
In delitijs fuerunt omenta ifititia, glandula suilla, laridum, perna, pes suillus, finciput, polimenta porcina.
Perna, abdomen, sumen, suis glandium, assa bubula, in delitijs.
Eaque solebant in carnario pro reliquijs asservari: ventris stabi- limenta.
Pro reliquijs frigidam pernam apponebant postridiè.
Perf. 1. 3. v. 2 s.
Pernam quidem jus est apponi frigidam postridiè, Mil. 3. 1. v. 164. Et halecem. Ibid.
Delicatiores cibi erant olivæ, pulpamentum leporis, capparis. Curc 1. 1. v. 90.
Conger & offa penita in delitijs, Mil. 3. 1. v. 164.
Conger & perna solebant frigidè asservari. Ibid.
Inter bellaria habebant olim laterculos, sesamum, papaverem, triticum, frictas nuces. Pæn. 1. 2. v. 112.
De singulis vide Lex. Plaut.
Cibus minimè lautus erat Epityrum Mil. 1. 1. v. 24.
Vide Lex. Plaut.
